items.title: 英偉達股價小漲，投資人繼續權衡黃仁勳離職一事。
items.titleEn: Nvidia stock inches higher as investors continue to weigh Jensen Huang’s departure
items.titleZh: 英偉達股價小漲，投資人繼續權衡黃仁勳離職一事。
items.summaryEn: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia on Thursday after coming under scrutiny for two extramarital affairs.
items.summaryZh: 週四，英偉達執行長黃仁勳因兩起婚外情醜聞受到審查後辭去了職務。

items.title: 英偉達執行長黃仁勳辭職，科萊特·克雷斯被任命為臨時執行長：即時更新
items.titleEn: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns, Colette Kress named interim chief: Live updates
items.titleZh: 英偉達執行長黃仁勳辭職，科萊特·克雷斯被任命為臨時執行長：即時更新
items.summaryEn: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has faced increased scrutiny since revealing an affair. Follow live updates on the investigation, NVDA stock and succession plans.
items.summaryZh: 自從英偉達執行長黃仁勳公開婚外情以來，他面臨越來越嚴格的審查。請關注調查的最新進展、英偉達股票走勢以及繼任計畫。

items.title: 聯準會古爾斯比稱通膨報告“令人不安”，央行正在考慮進一步升息。
items.titleEn: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
items.titleZh: 聯準會古爾斯比稱通膨報告“令人不安”，央行正在考慮進一步升息。
items.summaryEn: The consumer price index rose more than expected in October, raising alarm among Federal Reserve officials.
items.summaryZh: 10月消費者物價指數漲幅超乎預期，引起聯準會官員的警覺。

items.title: 10月消費者物價上漲0.4%，高於預期，加劇了聯準會應對通膨的難度。
items.titleEn: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
items.titleZh: 10月消費者物價上漲0.4%，高於預期，加劇了聯準會應對通膨的難度。
items.summaryEn: The report comes at a critical juncture for the Federal Reserve as it considers its next move regarding interest rates.
items.summaryZh: 這份報告發布之際，正值聯準會考慮下一步利率政策的關鍵時刻。

items.title: 英偉達股價下跌5%，外界關注焦點轉向黃仁勳與涉嫌中國間諜的關係
items.titleEn: Nvidia stock falls 5% as scrutiny turns to Jensen Huang’s relationship with alleged Chinese spy
items.titleZh: 英偉達股價下跌5%，外界關注焦點轉向黃仁勳與涉嫌中國間諜的關係
items.summaryEn: Nvidia said its board has launched an independent investigation following the reports that Huang was the target of a "foreign intelligence effort."
items.summaryZh: 英偉達表示，在有報道稱黃仁勳成為「外國情報機構」的目標後，其董事會已啟動獨立調查。

items.summaryEn: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., who is likely the next House speaker, has made clear that ending President Trump's tariffs is one of Democrats' top priorities.
items.summaryZh: 紐約州民主黨眾議員哈基姆·傑弗里斯很可能成為下一任眾議院議長，他已明確表示，結束川普總統的關稅是民主黨的首要任務之一。
